items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: if we played with hand, we'd work for weeks and wouldn't make a dime

ctx.x: Tell me about some of the different jobs you played, you know, like good jobs and bad jobs, exciting places and all this.

Well I played some nice jobs because I've seen, I played, when I was with Walter Pichot, we played at the Jung, played at the Roosevelt, played at the Roseanne Restaurant, played at I think it's, I don't know if it was on the one, we played at the Country Club. Those are all nice jobs. I mean of the high type of, and then I played, oh I played just a beer garden with four pieces, three pieces. And anybody played with hand, if you say bad jobs, if we played with hand, we'd work for weeks and wouldn't make a dime.…
